title: US appeals court rules 10-7 against bond hearings for immigrants detained after illegal entry
summary_full: The US Court of Appeals for the Fifth Circuit has made a pivotal ruling concerning immigrant detention, involving three men who unlawfully entered the country. The court decided to overturn earlier decisions that allowed them individualized bond hearings while awaiting removal proceedings. This change stirs substantial dialogue on the potential impacts on the constitutional rights of immigrants facing detention without due process.
